objective: Prepare a bounded repository change plan with dependency order and acceptance gates.

sources.content: The engine owns execution mechanics. The supervisor owns review and acceptance policy. Do not move workflow execution into the supervisor.

dependencies: Policy changes depend on the existing engine contract.
acceptance_criteria: No workflow execution logic moves into the supervisor.

claims.claim: The plan must preserve the engine and supervisor ownership boundary.

citations.quote: The engine owns execution mechanics. The supervisor owns review and acceptance policy.
